current_host_observations.canSave: Independent host explicitly requires no pending request, hasChanges, accountID, nonblank name and UTF8 budgets <=256; the source comments already label it host admission. Those rules are not established official validation.
current_host_observations.visible_gate: NativeProfileEditor Save alone uses disabled(!state.canSave) at observed line141. Source now proves a separate content-level isSaving disable carrier; preserving independent operation identity/receipt checks remains appropriate.

safe_product_decisions: Apply the source-proven busy enabled environment to the complete profile content; retain per-save progress and additional upload gate only when actual upload capability/state exists.
Keep host input budgets/nonblank and hasChanges admission explicitly independent. Do not describe these as recovered original validation or add username regex from common expectations.

Do not display accepted success on async scheduling/transport completion. Parent planned exact owner acceptance and local journal are independent frontend semantics, not original cache/transaction recovery.
Do not claim official automatic dismissal. Keep cancellation and owner accepted close policy explicit in the host until full original completion-to-dismiss consumer is closed.
